name: I-COVID-19
tagline: Okufanele ukwenze namuhla. I-COVID ende. Imigomo.

what_is_it.heading: I-COVID-19 ngokwemibandela esobala
what_is_it.lede: I-COVID-19 idalwa yigciwane le-SARS-CoV-2. Ngo-2026 isiphenduke insakavukela - ijikeleza unyaka wonke, ngamagagasi esizini. Amacala amaningi manje asethambile, kepha leli gciwane lisabulala abantu abasengozini.
paragraphs: Iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika like laba ne-COVID-19 noma ligonyiwe. Ukuzivikela komzimba okuhlanganisiwe kwenze lesi sifo saba buthakathaka kwabaningi. Izinhlobo ezintsha zisavela, futhi asebekhulile, abakhubazekile, nabangagonyiwe bahlala besengozini enkulu yokugula kakhulu.

I-COVID ende - izimpawu ezihlala izinyanga ngemuva kokutheleleka - zithinta ingxenye enengqondo yabantu abelulama ekuthelelekeni okukhulu. Ukukhathala, ukuphelelwa umoya, inkungu yobuchopho, nobuhlungu besifuba kuvamile. Ukunciphisa inani lezikhathi otheleleka ngazo kunciphisa ingcuphe yakho ende ye-COVID.

items.headline: I-Endemic
items.body: I-COVID manje isiyingxenye yokuphila unomphela. Amagagasi esizini ayaqhubeka. Ama-boosters asiza ukunciphisa ubunzima, hhayi ukumisa ukutheleleka ngokuphelele.

items.headline: I-COVID ende
items.body: Cishe i-10-20% yezifo iholela ezimpawu ezihlala izinyanga. Ukutheleleka ngakunye futhi kwengeza ingozi - ukutheleleka okumbalwa kungcono.

items.headline: Imithi yokugoma yamahhala
items.body: Yonke imithi yokugomela i-COVID kanye nezithuthukisi ezibuyekeziwe zihlala zimahhala emitholampilo kahulumeni. Kunconywe minyaka yonke emaqenjini asengozini enkulu.

items.headline: Ikakhulukazi ukunakekelwa kwasekhaya
items.body: Ezimweni eziningi zidinga ukuphumula, uketshezi, nesikhathi. Ama-antiviral akhona emaqenjini asengozini enkulu - bona umtholampilo zingakapheli izinsuku ezi-5 zezimpawu.

pull_quote.text: Isigaba sobhubhane sesiphelile. I-COVID-19 ayikho. Kuphathe njengomkhuhlane - goma, ngenisa umoya, hlala ekhaya lapho ugula, futhi uvikele abasengozini eduze nawe.

signs.heading: Ibukeka kanjani i-COVID manje
signs.lede: Izigameko eziningi zamanje ze-COVID zibukeka njengomkhuhlane noma umkhuhlane omncane. Ukulahlekelwa kwakudala kokunambitha nephunga okuvela kumagagasi angaphambili manje akusajwayelekile.

items.title: Izimpawu ezivamile
items.description: Umphimbo obuhlungu, ikhala eligijimayo, ukukhwehlela, ikhanda elibuhlungu, ukukhathala, umkhuhlane omncane, ubuhlungu bomzimba. Ngokuvamile kwenziwa iphutha njengomkhuhlane noma umkhuhlane.

items.title: Okungajwayelekile manje
items.description: Ukulahlekelwa ukunambitheka noma iphunga, ukuphefumula kanzima, ubuhlungu besifuba. Kusengenzeka - ikakhulukazi kubantu abangagonyiwe.

items.title: Thola usizo lwezempilo uma
items.description: Ukuphefumula kanzima, ubuhlungu besifuba, ukudideka, izindebe eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ukuhlanza okungapheli, noma izimpawu ziba zimbi ngemva kokuthuthuka kokuqala.

spreads.heading: Isakazeka kanjani i-COVID
yes: Ukuphefumula ngamaconsi amancane nama-aerosol avela kubantu abangenwe yileli gciwane
Vala ukuthintana isikhathi eside ezindaweni ezisendlini ezingenawo umoya ohlanzekile
Ukuthinta izindawo ezingcolile, bese uyathinta ubuso (okungavamile kakhulu kunokuhamba emoyeni)
Kumuntu onaleli gciwane kodwa ongakazizwa egula
no: Ukuxhumana okuvamile kwangaphandle (akuvamile ngaphandle uma kusondele kakhulu futhi isikhathi eside)
Izilwane ezifuywayo nezilwane (okungavamile futhi akubalulekile ekusakazeni komuntu)

items.fact: I-COVID isabalele, ayihambile. Kusabulala abantu abasengozini futhi kubangela izinkinga zesikhathi eside. Umqondo ojwayelekile ubalulekile — hhayi ukwethuka.

Ukungavikeleki ekuthelelekeni kwangaphambili kuyafiphala phakathi nezinyanga futhi kuyahlukahluka ngokuhlukahluka. Ukutheleleka kabusha kuvamile. Ukugoma kanye nokutheleleka kwangaphambilini kunikeza isivikelo esiqine kakhulu.

Iminyaka yedatha yomhlaba wonke ibonisa imithi yokugoma inciphisa ukugula okunzima, ukulaliswa esibhedlela, nokufa. Imiphumela emibi yomuthi wokugoma ayijwayelekile futhi ayijwayelekile kakhulu kunezinkinga ezinkulu ze-COVID.
I-COVID ende ibhalwe kahle ngokomzimba - ama-biomarker, ukulimala kwesitho, izinguquko zokuzivikela komzimba. Akukho ekhanda lesiguli. Ukwelashwa kuyathuthuka.

prevention.heading: Ungazivikela kanjani wena nabanye
prevention.lede: Ukuvimbela okuningi manje kuwumkhuba - njengomkhuhlane. Amaqembu asengozini enkulu asazuza kakhulu ezinyathelweni ezisebenzayo.

items.title: Hlala unolwazi lwakamuva ngama-booster
items.description: Ama-booster aminyaka yonke e-COVID anconyelwe abaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-50, abangenawo amandla omzimba, ukugula okungapheli, kanye nabasebenzi bezempilo. Kumahhala emitholampilo.

items.title: Ukungenisa umoya
items.description: Vula amawindi. Hambisa imibuthano yokuzijabulisa ngaphandle uma kungenzeka. Ikhwalithi yomoya wasendlini iyisici esisodwa esikhulu ekusakazekeni kwe-COVID.

items.title: Imaski kuzilungiselelo ezinobungozi obukhulu
items.description: Izibhedlela, imitholampilo, izithuthi zomphakathi ezigcwele ngaphakathi endlini ngesikhathi samagagasi. Ikakhulukazi uma uhlala nomuntu osengozini.

items.title: Hlala ekhaya uma ugula
items.description: Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi i-COVID, umkhuhlane, nanoma yini enye - ukuhlala ekhaya kuvikela abantu abaseduze nawe. Hlola ukuthi uyakwazi yini ukufinyelela.

items.title: Hlola ukuthi uyakwazi yini ukufinyelela
items.description: Ukuhlolwa kwe-antigen okusheshayo kuyatholakala emakhemisi amaningi. Ukwazi kukusiza ukuthi uvikele abanye futhi unqume ukuthi usengozini enkulu yini yezidambisigciwane.

items.title: Ukuphumula, uketshezi, i-paracetamol
items.description: Kuyafana nomkhuhlane. Lala, unike amanzi, ulawule imfiva kanye nezinhlungu nge-paracetamol noma ibuprofen.

items.title: Zihlukanise ngenkathi uthelela
items.description: Hlala ekhaya okungenani izinsuku ezi-5 kusukela ekuqaleni kwezimpawu. Zimboze amalungu omndeni. Gwema ukuvakashela asebekhulile noma izihlobo ezingenawo amandla omzimba.

items.title: Uma usengozini enkulu - bonana nomtholampilo kusenesikhathi
items.description: Over 60, abakhulelwe, izifo ezingamahlalakhona, immunocompromised? Imithi elwa namagciwane (i-Paxlovid) isebenza kahle kakhulu phakathi nezinsuku ezingu-5 zezimpawu. Buza kusenesikhathi.

items.title: Buka i-COVID ende
items.description: Izimpawu ezingaphezu kwamaviki angu-4 - ukukhathala, inkungu yobuchopho, ukuphefumula, ubuhlungu besifuba - zidinga ukuhlolwa kodokotela. Izinketho zokwelapha zikhona.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Ukunakekelwa kwe-COVID kuhlanganiswe nezinsizakalo zomtholampilo ezijwayelekile. Azikho izinombolo zocingo ezikhethekile ezidingekayo - umtholampilo wakho ovamile noma ikhemisi kungasiza.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Imithi yokugomela i-COVID yamahhala, izithuthukisi, nokuhlolwa kwezimpawu ezinzima
helplines.meta: Akukho ukuqokwa · alukho usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo
